selfReview.shape: One existing capture coordinator, catalog, acquisition owner and queue. Stateless service admission composition owns no table, lifecycle, timer or retry queue. One service close lifetime also owns pending listener startup.
selfReview.diff: Removed optional initialization guards after owners became definite; public admission diagnostics do not hide lifecycle facts; shared request prefix has one definition.
selfReview.docs: Child records source discovery, managed-root/lifetime rules, scripted evidence boundaries and pending root integration; parent handoff remains root-owned.
selfReview.tests: Actual public socket/private control channel and compiled CLI/MCP adapters; external worker replies scripted. Expected production regressions observed red; priority/startup mutants restored and final gates green.

independentReview.mode: Root source review plus final independent source-only collision review relayed by root; not a native or media run.

findings.finding: EOF during socket bind could release the catalog and then return a late listener; already-ended input could miss end notification.
findings.resolution: Shared close owns the in-flight listener promise before opening control; startup refuses after close. openControl notices already-ended streams on a microtask. Both EOF cases and unanswered-start drain are checked.

findings.finding: Fresh capture donors used home/recordings outside the managed library root.
findings.resolution: Fresh capture/coordinator admission use library root; actual private path and storage bytes checked. Installed main stays unchanged.

findings.finding: An explicit import occupying the internal capture request made recording discovery and successful transition replies fail.
findings.resolution: Derive admissionError REQUEST_CONFLICT from durable conflicting row while preserving capture facts and null capture ownership; never borrow other import job/acquisition. Actual collision red/green checks plus clean final independent source-only review.

independentReview.finalCollisionVerdict: clean: narrow durable conflict handling, truthful null ownership/diagnostic, independent import preserved, read/replay controls and no auto-retry.

limitations: Codex CLI/Claude review retry not invoked per root scope.
No native/media/profile/inference/UI/physical capture checks; no installed service cutover.
Source-only recording deletion/cleanup port remains unavailable and outside this pass.
